subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should WhatsApp sticker support transport only sticker-ready WebP, or also convert arbitrary static and animated media into compliant stickers?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable but define different user promises, dependency needs, failure behavior, metadata handling, and validation scope; source inspection cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Transport sticker-ready WebP
options.body: Expose a plugin-owned sticker action that validates and sends already-compliant WebP while returning clear errors for invalid media.

options.title: Build full sticker conversion
options.body: Accept common image and animation formats and add a standards-compliant conversion pipeline covering static and animated WebP plus required metadata.

options.title: Keep the primitive internal
options.body: Leave `sendSticker` as a private runtime capability and do not expose outbound sticker support through the message tool.

recommendation.title: Transport sticker-ready WebP
recommendation.body: Expose a plugin-owned sticker action that validates and sends already-compliant WebP while returning clear errors for invalid media.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp send/media history and the existing maintainer-side issue review make this person the strongest available owner for choosing the user-facing contract.
